text: The Goa Ayurvedic and other Allied Indian Systems of Medicine Council Act, 2019 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 201915 Act Number: 15 Enactment Date: 2019-08-09 Act Year: 2019 Short Title: The Goa Ayurvedic and other Allied Indian Systems of Medicine Council Act, 2019 Long Title: To provide for the constitution of the Goa Council of Ayurvedic and other Allied Indian Systems of Medicine, registration of practitioners in said medicines, maintenance of register of practitioners, qualifications of practitioners, the practice of such medicines and with a view to encourage the study, spread of such system of medicines and to make certain other provisions, relating to the practitioners generally in the State of Goa.
